crossRefs.note: and he said: “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring…
I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
When your days are fulfilled, and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed…
He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring…
I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
but they will serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
translations.bsb: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”
translations.kjv: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
translations.asv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
